title: diospyros oblonga var. helferi
intro: Diospyros oblonga var. helferi, commonly known as Indian Persimmon, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ebenaceae. It is a deciduous tree native to the Himalayas and is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic effects. The therapeutic actions of Diospyros oblonga var. helferi include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and treat various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
